rules.statement: A Kandyan deed of gift executed after the Kandyan Law Declaration and Amendment Ordinance came into operation is irrevocable if the donor has expressly renounced his right to revoke, even if an undertaking was given by the donee to give succour and assistance during the donor's lifetime.
rules.supporting_quote: "A Kandyan deed of gift executed after the Kandyan Law Declaration and Amendment Ordinance came into operation is irrevocable if the donor has expressly renounced his right to revoke and, although an undertaking was given by the donee to give succour and assistance to the donor during the donor's life-time, the undertaking was not one of the conditions on which the grant was made to the donee by the donor."
